title: erodium malacoides var. ribifolium
intro: Erodium malacoides var. ribifolium, commonly known as the Red-stemmed Heron's Bill, is a plant species in the geranium family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Erodium malacoides var. ribifolium include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and diuretic, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
